y-m-14-05.title: Ingaba 'ukuba linolungelelanise lomgca, linolungelelanise lamachaphaza' liyinyani? Ukuvavanya ngomzekelo ochasayo
y-m-14-05.topic: Imifanekiso enolungelelanise lomgca nolwamachaphaza: imizekelo echasayo
y-m-14-05.goal: Vavanya, ngokusonga nangokujika, ukuba isigqibo esibanzi ngemifanekiso enolungelelanise lomgca nolwamachaphaza (ingxelo yesibini) isoloko sisebenza na, wenze uchaze nomzekelo ochasayo ngokwakho.
y-m-14-05.material: UHaram wathi, “Ukuba umfanekiso unolungelelanise lomgca, unolungelelanise lamachaphaza nawo.” Umfanekiso onolungelelanise lomgca ngumfanekiso ofanela ngqo phezu kwawo xa usongwa ecaleni komgca, kwaye umfanekiso onolungelelanise lamachaphaza ngumfanekiso ofanela ngqo phezu komfanekiso wokuqala xa ujikwa isiqingatha sejika (180°) ejikeleza ichaphaza. Akukho mifanekiso, ngoko cinga ngemifanekiso ngamagama ayo. Cinga unxande njengongesosikwere, kunye ne-parallelogram njengengesiyonxande okanye irombhasi.
y-m-14-05.thinking.1: Ukwahlula iindlela ezimbini zokujonga, ukusonga nokujika isiqingatha sejika
y-m-14-05.thinking.2: Ukwenza umzekelo wakho ochasayo wengxelo engasebenziyo
y-m-14-05.prereq.0: Umfanekiso onolungelelanise lomgca: umfanekiso ofanela ngqo phezu kwawo xa usongwa ecaleni komgca
y-m-14-05.prereq.1: Umfanekiso onolungelelanise lamachaphaza: umfanekiso ofanela ngqo phezu komfanekiso wokuqala xa ujikwa isiqingatha sejika (180°) ejikeleza ichaphaza
y-m-14-05.s.s1.prompt: Phakathi kwemifanekiso engezantsi, khetha yonke imifanekiso ebonisa ukuba ingxelo kaHaram ethi 'ukuba umfanekiso unolungelelanise lomgca, unolungelelanise lamachaphaza nawo' ayinyani.
y-m-14-05.s.s1.hint.0: Kumfanekiso ngamnye, bhala kwitheyibhile enemiqolo emibini 'Ngaba likho umgca onokuwusonga ukuze ufanele?' kunye 'Ingaba iyafanela xa ijikwa isiqingatha sejika?'
y-m-14-05.s.s1.hint.1: Yithi yimaphi amaqela eebhokisi kwitheyibhile owafunayo ukuze uyiphule ingxelo kaHaram.
y-m-14-05.s.s1.r.a: Olu khetho lujonge zombini ukuba lufanela na xa lusongwa nokuba lufanela na xa lujikwa isiqingatha sejika.
y-m-14-05.s.s1.r.b: Unxande ufanela zombini xa usongwa okanye xa ujikwa, ngoko akaphikisani nengxelo kaHaram. Ukubonisa ukuba ingxelo iphosakele, ufuna umfanekiso onolungelelanise lomgca kodwa ongenalungelelanise lamachaphaza.
y-m-14-05.s.s1.r.c: I-parallelogram ayinawo umgca onokuwusonga ukuze ifanele. Ukuvavanya ingxelo kaHaram, umfanekiso kufuneka kuqala ube nolungelelanise lomgca.
y-m-14-05.s.s1.r.d: Olu khetho lujonge zombini umgca owenza ufanele xa usongwa nokuba ufanela na xa ujikwa.
y-m-14-05.s.s1.r.e: Irombhasi ifanela zombini xa isongwa okanye xa ijikwa, ngoko ayiphikisani nengxelo kaHaram.
y-m-14-05.s.s1.explain: Umzekelo ochasayo ngumfanekiso 'onolungelelanise lomgca kodwa ongenalungelelanise lamachaphaza'. Unxantathu onamacala alinganayo nepentagoni eqhelekileyo zinemigca ezifanela ngayo xa zisongwa, kodwa azifaneli kumfanekiso wokuqala xa zijikwa isiqingatha sejika. Unxande nerombhasi zifanela ngeendlela zombini, kwaye i-parallelogram inolungelelanise lamachaphaza kodwa ayinalungelelanise lomgca, ngoko ayinakuba ngumzekelo ochasayo kule ngxelo.
y-m-14-05.s.s2.prompt: Ngeli xesha uHaram wathi okuchasene noko. “Ukuba umfanekiso unolungelelanise lamachaphaza, unolungelelanise lomgca nawo.” I-parallelogram engesiyonxande okanye irombhasi ifanela umfanekiso wokuqala xa ijikwa isiqingatha sejika ejikeleza ichaphaza. Ungayigweba njani ingxelo yesibini kaHaram usebenzisa le parallelogram?
y-m-14-05.s.s2.hint.0: Zama ukusika i-parallelogram ephepheni uze ubone ukuba likho na indlela yokuyisonga ukuze amacala omabini afanele.
y-m-14-05.s.s2.hint.1: Yithi ngumfanekiso wohlobo luni owaneleyo ukubonisa ukuba ingxelo ethi 'ihlala iyinyani' iphosakele.
y-m-14-05.s.s2.o.a: Ukuba uyijikisa i-parallelogram isiqingatha sokujika, iyagqagqana nemo yasekuqaleni, ngoko ngumzekelo obonisa ukuba isitatimenti esithi "ukuba ilingana ngamachaphaza, ilingana ngomgca" silunge
y-m-14-05.s.s2.r.a: Ukhangele kuphela ukuba ilingana ngamachaphaza kwaye awuzange ukhangele ukuba ilingana ngomgca na. Ukuze isitatimenti silunge, kufuneka ilingane nangomgca.
y-m-14-05.s.s2.o.b: Imo enye ayinakubonisa ukuba isitatimenti asilunganga, ngoko kufuneka sigqibe emva kokujonga ezimbalwa ezifanayo ngakumbi
y-m-14-05.s.s2.r.b: Ushiyele ecaleni into yokuba igama elithi 'ngalo lonke ixesha' linokophulwa ngumzekelo omnye nje.
y-m-14-05.s.s2.o.c: I-parallelogram ayinawo umgca owenza iihafu zigqagqane xa isonjululwa, ngoko le mo inye ibonisa ukuba isitatimenti asilunganga
y-m-14-05.s.s2.r.c: Esi sigqibo sidibanisa indlela yokukhangela nesigqibo.
y-m-14-05.s.s2.o.d: Ukuba iyagqagqana xa isonjululwa nokuba iyagqagqana xa ijikiswa kujonga ipropathi efanayo, ngoko ukukhangela enye kwanele
y-m-14-05.s.s2.r.d: Ukukhangela okubini kujonga iipropathi ezahlukeneyo. Ezinye iimo zinayo enye kuphela kuzo.
y-m-14-05.s.s2.explain: Ukuze 'ukuba imo ilingana ngamachaphaza, ilingana ngomgca' kulunge ngalo lonke ixesha, yonke imo elingana ngamachaphaza ibifanele ibe nomgca ahambelana ngawo xa isonjululwa. I-parallelogram engeyiyo inxande okanye i-rhombus ayinawo umgca ahambelana ngawo xa isonjululwa, ngoko ngumzekelo ochasayo olingana ngamachaphaza kodwa ungalingani ngomgca. Umzekelo ochasayo omnye wanele ukophula 'ngalo lonke ixesha'.
y-m-14-05.s.s3.prompt: Nika imo enye, engekho phakathi kokhetho olungasentla, elingana ngomgca kodwa ingalingani ngamachaphaza. Bhala ukuba ibonakala njani xa isonjululwa nokuba ibonakala njani xa ijikiswa isiqingatha sokujika, uze ucacise ukuba kutheni loo mo ngumzekelo ochasayo kwisitatimenti sokuqala sikaHaram.
y-m-14-05.s.s3.hint.0: Misela imo, uze uqale ubhale apho unokuzoba khona umgca ahambelana ngawo xa isonjululwa.
y-m-14-05.s.s3.hint.1: Landela apho kuya khona inxalenye eyayiphezulu xa ujikisa leyo mo isiqingatha sokujika.
y-m-14-05.s.s3.placeholder: Umzekelo: Unxantathu onemilenze elinganayo, xa usonjululwa, ... Xa ujikiswa isiqingatha sokujika, ...
y-m-14-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Utshilo ukuba umgca ukuphi, ukubonisa ukuba imo oyinikileyo inene iyahambelana xa isonjululwa?
y-m-14-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ubhale isizathu sokuba ingahambelani nemo yasekuqaleni xa ijikiswa isiqingatha sokujika (yeyiphi inxalenye eya phi)?
y-m-14-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Unike imo eyahlukileyo kunxantathu olinganayo nepentagoni eqhelekileyo?
y-m-14-05.s.s3.model.0: Unxantathu onemilenze elinganayo (unxantathu onamacala amabini abude bulinganayo) uhambelana kumacala omabini ukuba umsonjulula usuka kwincopho ukuya embindini wesiseko, ngoko ulingana ngomgca. Kodwa xa ujikiswa isiqingatha sokujika incopho iya ezantsi kwaye ayihambelani nemo yasekuqaleni, ngoko akalingani ngamachaphaza.
y-m-14-05.s.s3.model.1: Itrapheziyam enemilenze elinganayo enecala elingezantsi elide kunelingaphezulu ihambelana xa isonjululwa ngembindi wasekhohlo nasekunene. Kodwa xa ijikiswa isiqingatha sokujika icala elide liya phezulu kwaye ayihambelani nemo yasekuqaleni, ngoko ayiyiyo imo elingana ngamachaphaza.

y-m-14-06.title: Zingaphi iintlobo zeefreyimu zeprizim enxande onokuzenza ngocingo olungama-60 cm?
y-m-14-06.topic: Iprizim enxande: isixa sobude beenqenqema nokuyila imo
y-m-14-06.goal: Chaza imeko yesixa sobude beenqenqema njengolingano, ufumane ngaphandle kokushiya naziphi na zonke iifreyimu zeprizim enxande ezihlangabezana neemeko ezininzi, uze ucacise ukuba kunokungabikho freyimu xa iimeko zitshintsha.
y-m-14-06.material: Ufuna ukusebenzisa ucingo lonke olungama-60 cm, ngaphandle kokushiya nto, ukwenza ifreyimu (isakhelo esingenamacala) eyenziwe ngeenqenqema zeprizim enxande kuphela. Ucingo lunokunqunyulwa lujoyinwe, kodwa akufuneki ushiye ucezu nolunye olungasetyenzisiweyo okanye ukugqagqanisa nawuphi. Ubude, ububanzi nokuphakama zonke ngamanani emvelo (cm). Inqenqema ende yefreyimu kufuneka ibe yi-9 cm okanye ngaphezulu, kwaye inqenqema emfutshane kufuneka ibe yi-2 cm okanye ngaphezulu.

y-m-14-06.thinking.2: Ukugweba ukuba kunokungabikho sisombululo xa iimeko zitshintsha

y-m-14-02.title: Kufuneka sazi ntoni ukumisela indawo yephepha le-kite enye?
y-m-14-02.topic: Indawo ye-rhombus: ulwazi olufunekayo ukumisela indawo
y-m-14-02.goal: Hlela ulwazi olwaneleyo nolungonelanga ukumisela indawo ye-rhombus, yila ii-rhombus ezahlukeneyo ezinendawo efanayo, uze uchaze ukuba kutheni ubude becala yodwa bungamiseli indawo.
y-m-14-02.material: Indawo yokusebenza yenza ii-kite zephepha ngemo ye-rhombus. I-rhombus yiquadrilateral apho onke amacala amane anobude obufanayo. I-kite nganye iza nolwazi olwahlukileyo, kwaye sifuna ukusebenza ukuba olo lwazi lodwa lumisela, njengexabiso elinye, indawo yephepha elisetyenziselwa ukwenza i-kite enye. Bonke ubude buyi-cm, kwaye i-kite ithathwa njengeshiti enye ethe tye yephepha. Amaqhekeza olwazi angezantsi ngee-kite ezahlukeneyo.
y-m-14-02.thinking.1: Ukucinga oko kwahlukileyo ngeendlela ezininzi ngenxa yolwazi olusilelayo
y-m-14-02.prereq.0: Ukwazi ukuba i-rhombus yiquadrilateral apho onke amacala amane anobude obufanayo
y-m-14-02.prereq.1: Ukwazi iidayagonali ze-rhombus kunye neseko nokuphakama kweparallelogram
y-m-14-02.s.s1.prompt: Ukusuka kulwazi olungezantsi, khetha zonke izinto apho ukwazi iqhekeza elinye lolwazi kuphela kukuvumela ukumisela indawo yephepha le-kite njengexabiso elinye.
y-m-14-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kwiqhekeza ngalinye lolwazi, hlola ukuba ungacinga i-rhombus eyanelisa ngqo kodwa inendawo eyahlukileyo.
y-m-14-02.s.s1.hint.1: Thatha isakhelo se-rhombus esenziwe ngokudibanisa iintonga ezine uze usicinezele sibe tyaba ukusuka kwicala elinye. Jonga into etshintshayo nento ehlala injalo.
y-m-14-02.s.s1.o.a: Onke amacala amane angama-30 cm, ngoko umjikelezo ngama-120 cm
y-m-14-02.s.s1.r.a: Nokuba ubude bamacala buyafana, indawo itshintsha xa i-rhombus icinezelwa ibe tyaba okanye imiswa. Ubude becala abumiseli ukuba itsalele kangakanani.
y-m-14-02.s.s1.o.b: Icala elinye li-20 cm, kwaye ukuphakama kweli cala yi-18 cm
y-m-14-02.s.s1.r.b: Lo ngumbono wokubona i-rhombus njengeparallelogram eneseko nokuphakama, ngoko indawo yayo inokumiselwa.
y-m-14-02.s.s1.r.c: Nokuba idayagonali enye ifanayo, indawo iyatshintsha ukuba enye idayagonali iba nde okanye iba mfutshane.
y-m-14-02.s.s1.o.d: Ubude bedayagonali ezimbini bu-40 cm kunye ne-24 cm
y-m-14-02.s.s1.r.d: Le yingcinga yokuba ubude bedayagonali ezimbini bumisela ubungakanani nemo yerombhasi.
y-m-14-02.s.s1.r.e: Ubungakanani bengile bumisela kuphela imo yethambeka, hayi ubungakanani (ubude). Zikho iirombhasi ezininzi njengoko ufuna ezinobungakanani obahlukileyo.
y-m-14-02.s.s1.explain: Ukumisela indawo, kufuneka wazi ubungakanani nemo kunye. y-m-14-04.s.s1.hint.0: Ngalo lonke ixesha ufumana ulwazi, cinga ukuba ungazoba na oonxantathu ababini bobungakanani obahlukileyo bobabini abanelisa olo lwazi.
y-m-14-04.s.s1.hint.1: Kulwazi 2, qala uzobe icala elingu-7 cm, uze uzobe iingile kumazantsi omabini uze ulandele apho imigca emibini idibana khona.
y-m-14-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Ulwazi 1: Iingile ezintathu zikanxantathu ㄱㄴㄷ zezi: i-engile ㄱ ingu-40°, i-engile ㄴ ingu-60°, kwaye i-engile ㄷ ingu-80°.
y-m-14-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ngolu lwazi kuphela, ungazoba unxantathu omnye ofanela ngqo phezu konxantathu kaSeoa?
y-m-14-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Nokuba iingile ziyafana, zikho oonxantathu bobungakanani obahlukileyo (bazotywe bengabakhulu okanye bencinci). Iingile zithi imo ithambeke kangakanani, kodwa azichazi bungakanani. Kufuneka ulwazi olungakumbi olumisela ubungakanani.
y-m-14-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ungakwazi. Ukuba iingile ezintathu ziyafana, ngoko hayi imo kuphela kodwa nobungakanani buba bufanayo ngqo.
y-m-14-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uthathe ukuba iingile ezifanayo zithetha ukuba ubungakanani bufanayo nabo. Iingile zichaza kuphela ukuba kuthambeka kangakanani.
y-m-14-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Akumiselwanga njengokunye. Nokuba iingile ziyafana, unokuzoba oonxantathu bobungakanani obahlukileyo.
y-m-14-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Olu khetho lwenziwe ngokucinga ngoonxantathu abanengile ezifanayo kodwa ubungakanani obahlukileyo.
y-m-14-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Asikwazi ukuthi okwangoku. Kufuneka sitshintshe ubungakanani sizobe ngokwethu ukuze sazi.
y-m-14-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Olu khetho luqale lacinga indlela yokujonga uqikelelo.
y-m-14-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Ulwazi 2: Ubude becala ㄴㄷ, elinengile ㄴ (60°) nengile ㄷ (80°) emazantsi alo omabini, bu-7 cm.
y-m-14-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Olu lwazi lwongezwe kulwazi 1. Ngoku ngaba unxantathu ofanela ngqo phezu konxantathu kaSeoa umiselwe njengomnye?
y-m-14-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Ukuba uzoba icala elingu-7 cm ㄴㄷ uze uzobe i-60° ne-80° emazantsi alo omabini, imigca emibini idibana kwichaphaza elinye ㄱ, kwaye unxantathu umiselwa njengomnye. Ngeengile kuphela wawungawazi ubungakanani, kodwa icala elinye limisela ubungakanani.
y-m-14-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Akukamiselwa njengokunye. Ngobude becala elinye kuphela, ubude bamanye amacala amabini bunokwahluka ngeendlela ezininzi.
y-m-14-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Olu gwebo alujongi indlela eli cala neengile ezidityaniswe ngayo, nangona icala elinye lisaziwa.
y-m-14-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Kumiselwe njengokunye. Ukuba uzoba i-60° ne-80° emazantsi amabini ecala elingu-7 cm, ichaphaza eliseleyo limiselwa kwindawo enye.
y-m-14-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Olu gwebo lusebenzise into yokuba icala neengile ziqhagamshelene.
y-m-14-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Asikwazi ukugweba ukuba kumisiwe na, kuba asazi ukuba icala ㄴㄷ lilele phakathi kweengile zeziphi.
y-m-14-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Uphosise indawo esele ibhaliwe kulwazi. Funda kwakhona ukuba iingile emazantsi omabini ecala ㄴㄷ zezi phi.
y-m-14-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Ulwazi 3: Ngeli xesha, kunxantathu owahlukileyo ㅁㅂㅅ, kunikwe kuphela ubude bamacala amabini. Icala ㅁㅂ li-7 cm kwaye icala ㅂㅅ li-5 cm, kwaye iingile nobude becala eliseleyo azaziwa.
y-m-14-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ukuba ubuxelelwa nje enye into ukuze unxantathu ㅁㅂㅅ umiselwe njengomnye, luluphi ulwazi olwalunokunceda? (Khetha ezincedayo.)
y-m-14-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Ubude bamacala amabini bodwa abumiseli unxantathu. Ukuba unikwa i-engile ephakathi kwamacala amabini okanye ubude becala eliseleyo, kumiselwa. Ulwazi olunika igama kuphela, njengonxantathu onamacala alinganayo okanye unxantathu obukhali, luncitisa izinto ezinokwenzeka kodwa alumiseli nxantathu mnye.
y-m-14-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Ubungakanani bengile ㅁㅂㅅ, i-engile phakathi kwecala ㅁㅂ necala ㅂㅅ
y-m-14-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Olu khetho lwenziwe ngokucinga ukuba i-engile ephakathi kwamacala imisela ukuba amacala amabini avuleka kude kangakanani.
y-m-14-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ukuba unxantathu ㅁㅂㅅ unxantathu onamacala amabini alinganayo (unxantathu onamacala amabini obude obulinganayo)
y-m-14-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ukuba unamacala amabini alinganayo, icala eliseleyo lingaba li-7 cm okanye li-5 cm, izinto ezimbini ezinokwenzeka, ngoko akukamiselwa njengokunye.
y-m-14-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Olu khetho lwenziwe ngokucinga ukuba ukuba bonke ubude bamacala amathathu banikiwe, unxantathu uyamiselwa.
y-m-14-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Ukuba unxantathu ㅁㅂㅅ unxantathu obukhali (unxantathu oneengile ezintathu zonke zincinci kune-engile engqukuva)
y-m-14-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ngolwazi kuphela lokuba zonke iingile ezintathu zincinci kune-engile engqukuva, ubude becala eliseleyo bunokuphuma ngeendlela ezininzi.
y-m-14-04.s.s1.reflect: Jonga indlela ugwebo lwakho olutshintshe ngayo ukusuka kulwazi 1 ukuya kulwazi 2. Ekuqaleni kulula ukukholelwa ukuba iingile zodwa ziyaneleyo. Kodwa iingile zimisela imo kuphela, ngelixa ubude bumisela nobungakanani. Ukuba ngalo lonke ixesha ulwazi lwanda, ubuza 'yintoni enokuba yinto ezininzi okwangoku?', ungahlula izizathu zokutshintsha ugwebo kwizizathu zokulugcina.
y-m-14-04.s.s2.prompt: UHaram wathi, 'Naziphi na ezimbini iikwadrilatharali ezinobude bamacala onke amane bungama-5 cm ziyalingana ngalo lonke ixesha.' Gweba ukuba oku kuchanekile na, uchaze isizathu okanye unike umzekelo.
y-m-14-04.s.s2.hint.0: Zoba ikwadrilatharali enye enamacala amane onke angama-5 cm, uze ubambe enye incopho uyisondeze ecaleni ukutshintsha imo.
y-m-14-04.s.s2.hint.1: Jonga ukuba ikwadrilatharali ngaphambi kokusondeza neyangoku emva kokusondeza zinokufanela ngqo enye phezu kwenye na.
y-m-14-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Kumzekelo owunikileyo, ngaba kucacile ukuba kutheni ezi kwadrilatharali zimbini zingafaneli enye phezu kwenye nangona amacala amane efanayo?
y-m-14-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uthe, ngokungafaniyo nonxantathu, imo yekwadrilatharali ayimiselwa bubude bamacala bodwa?
y-m-14-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ngaba wazi kwaye wabhala ukuba umzekelo omnye uyakwazi ukuyiphula igama elithi 'ngalo lonke ixesha'?
y-m-14-04.s.s2.model.0: Hayi. Nokuba onke amacala amane angama-5 cm, isikwere kunye nerombhasi eyenziwe ngokucinezela eso sikwere ecaleni zinobungakanani bengile obahlukileyo, ngoko azilingani. Imo yekwadrilatharali ayimiselwa bubude bamacala bodwa.
y-m-14-04.s.s2.model.1: Zisenokungalingani. Ukuba ucinezela ingaphezulu lesikwere esinamacala amane angama-5 cm ecaleni usiqengqelekise, ubude bamacala buhlala bunjalo kodwa imo iyatshintsha, ngoko ayifaneli phezu kwekwadrilatharali yokuqala.
y-m-14-04.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ndichaze ngamazwi inkqubo yokucinezela nokuqengqelekisa isikwere.

y-m-14-07.title: Isisombululo sokuba zingaphi iithayile ekufuneka zibekwe: kuhamba kakubi phi?
y-m-14-07.topic: Iiyunithi zendawo: ukuguqula phakathi kwe-m² ne-cm², nokubeka iithayile
y-m-14-07.goal: Fumana uze ulungise impazamo eyenziwe xa kuguqulwa phakathi kwe-m² ne-cm², ufumane ngeendlela ezininzi iimeko apho iithayile zinokubekwa ngaphandle kokunqunyulwa nangaphandle kwezikhewu, uze ugwebe ukuba iyenzeka na xa iimeko zitshintsha.
y-m-14-07.material: Ufuna ukugubungela umgangatho weklasi ngeethayile ezisisikwere ezingama-40 cm macala onke. Umgangatho weklasi yinxande ende ngee-6 m kwaye ibanzi nge-4 m. Iithayile aziqwanyaziswa, kwaye zigubungela umgangatho wonke ngaphandle kwezikhewu okanye ukugqagqana. (1 m = 100 cm)
y-m-14-07.thinking.2: Ukuthelekisa izizathu ezibini zokuba into ingenzeki
y-m-14-07.s.s1.prompt: UYunseo wafumana inani leethayile ezifunekayo ngolu hlobo. Khetha umgca wokuqala ohamba kakubi.
y-m-14-07.s.s1.hint.0: Ecaleni komgca ngamnye, bhala ukuba iyunithi esetyenzisiweyo yi-m, i-m², i-cm, okanye i-cm².
y-m-14-07.s.s1.hint.1: Guqula isikwere esinamacala e-1 m sibe zii-cm, uze ufumane indawo yaso ngqo nge-cm².
y-m-14-07.s.s1.line.2: 1 m yi-100 cm, ngoko i-24 m² yi-2400 cm².
y-m-14-07.s.s1.line.3: Inani leethayile yi-2400÷1600=1.5, ngoko iithayile ezi-2 zanele.
y-m-14-07.s.s1.explain: Umgca wesi-3 uhamba kakubi. Kuba 1 m=100 cm, i-1 m² sisikwere esingu-100 cm nge-100 cm, ngoko yi-100×100=10000 cm². Emva koko i-24 m² yi-240000 cm², kwaye 240000÷1600=150 iithayile. Xa kuthelekiswa nenyaniso yokuba nomgca omnye ufuna iithayile ezili-15, 'iithayile ezi-2' emgceni wesi-4 azinabo ubuhlobo.
y-m-14-07.s.s2.prompt: Khetha icala lethayile esisikwere enokugubungela umgangatho we-6 m nge-4 m ngaphandle kwezikhewu nangaphandle kokunqunyulwa kweethayile. Icala kufuneka libe linani lemvelo (cm) ukusuka kwi-10 cm ukuya kwi-100 cm. Fumana ubungakanani obu-3 obahlukeneyo.
y-m-14-07.s.s2.hint.0: Misela ubude obunye becala lethayile, uze ukhangele ukuba iithayile zihambelana ncam kuwo wonke ama-600 cm kwicala lobude.
y-m-14-07.s.s2.hint.1: Nokuba ubungakanani buhambelana kubude, khangela ngokwahlukileyo ukuba ikho into eseleyo okanye ayanelanga kububanzi be-400 cm.
y-m-14-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Linani lemvelo ukusuka kwi-10 cm ukuya kwi-100 cm.
y-m-14-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Icala lethayile kufuneka libe linani lemvelo (cm) ukusuka kwi-10 cm ukuya kwi-100 cm.
y-m-14-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Igubungela ubude be-600 cm ngaphandle kwezikhewu.
y-m-14-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Kubude be-600 cm, iithayile ziyasala okanye aziyaneli.
y-m-14-07.s.s2.ok.c3: Igubungela ububanzi be-400 cm ngaphandle kwezikhewu.
y-m-14-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Kububanzi be-400 cm, iithayile ziyasala okanye aziyaneli.
y-m-14-07.s.s2.explain: Ukusuka kwi-10 cm ukuya kwi-100 cm, ubungakanani obusebenzayo buzizithandathu: 10, 20, 25, 40, 50, kunye ne-100 cm. Umzekelo, nge-50 cm, kungena iithayile eziyi-12 kubude kunye nezi-8 kububanzi, ngoko kufuneka iithayile ezingama-96. Nge-30 cm okanye i-60 cm ubude buyasebenza, kodwa kububanzi be-400 cm azihambelani ncam.
y-m-14-07.s.s3.prompt: Igumbi litshintshele kubude be-6 m nobubanzi be-4.5 m. Ufuna ukugweba ukuba umgangatho awunakugutyungelwa ngaphandle kwezikhewu xa kusetyenziswa iithayile ezifanayo ezingama-40 cm ngaphandle kokuzinqumla. Khetha zonke izizathu ezifanelekileyo zesi sigqibo.
y-m-14-07.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ukuba ngawaphi amanani amele abe ngamanani emvelo kwindlela esebenzisa indawo nakwindlela esebenzisa ubude.
y-m-14-07.s.s3.hint.1: Guqula i-6 m ibe yi-600 cm ne-4.5 m ibe yi-450 cm, uze ubone ukuba zingaphi iithayile ezingena kwicala ngalinye.
y-m-14-07.s.s3.o.a: Ukuba wahlula indawo i-27 m²=270000 cm² ngee-1600 cm² zethayile, ufumana iithayile ezili-168.75, elingelilo inani lemvelo
y-m-14-07.s.s3.r.a: Olu cwangciso lwagwetywa yimeko yokuba inani leethayile kufuneka libe linani lemvelo.
y-m-14-07.s.s3.o.b: I-4.5 m ayilolo inani lemvelo, ngoko nasemva kokuguqula ibe ziicm asikwazi ukubala ukuba zingaphi iithayile ezingena kumgca omnye
y-m-14-07.s.s3.r.b: Esi sigqibo sathi iithayile azinakubekwa ngenxa nje yokuba kuvele idesimali. I-450 cm bubude beenani zemvelo.
y-m-14-07.s.s3.o.c: Ukuba ubeka iithayile kumgca omnye ecaleni lobubanzi be-450 cm, kungena iithayile ezili-11 kwaye kusala i-10 cm, ngoko ayinakugutyungelwa ngaphandle kokunqunyulwa
y-m-14-07.s.s3.r.c: Olu cwangciso lukhangele imeko usebenzisa ubude kwicala elinye.
y-m-14-07.s.s3.o.d: Igumbi likhulile, ngoko ukuba kusetyenziswa iithayile ezininzi, ingxaki yobungakanani obungahambelaniyo iyanyamalala, kwaye inokugutyungelwa ngaphandle kokunqunyulwa
y-m-14-07.s.s3.r.d: Olu cwangciso lucinge ukuba ukusebenzisa iithayile ezininzi kwenza ingxaki yobungakanani obungahambelaniyo inyamalale. Ingxaki ayiyiyo inani leethayile kodwa kukuba ubude buhambelana ncam na.
y-m-14-07.s.s3.explain: Ngendawo, 270000÷1600=168.75, nangobude, 450÷40=11.25, ngoko zombini ziyawuxhasa isigqibo sokuba ayinakugutyungelwa ngaphandle kwezikhewu ngaphandle kokuba iithayile ziyanqunyulwa. Into yokuba i-4.5 m yidesimali okanye yokuba inani leethayile liyanyuswa asisosizathu.

y-m-14-08.title: Ukuba uqikelela indawo yamagqabi ngegridi, ungaya kude kangakanani kwiziphumo ozithethayo?
y-m-14-08.goal: Chaza indawo yemo ethe gabalala njengoluhlu usebenzisa inani lezikwere zegridi, lungisa ukuqiniseka kwakho ngokokuba uluhlu lutshintsha njani xa igridi yenziwa incinci, uze ucacise indlela yokunika ingxelo yoqikelelo.
y-m-14-08.material: Ubeke igqabi kwiphepha legridi apho isikwere ngasinye sibanzi nge-1 cm kwaye siphakame nge-1 cm, waza wazoba ingqukumbela yalo. Indawo yesikwere esinye segridi yi-1 cm². UHyunwoo ufuna ukuqikelela indawo yalo mzobo wegqabi. Ingqukumbela ithe gabalala, ngoko ayihambelani ncam nezikwere.
y-m-14-08.prereq.1: Ukuqikelela indawo usebenzisa indawo yesikwere esinye segridi nenani lezikwere
y-m-14-08.s.s1.prompt: Ngalo lonke ixesha ufumana ulwazi, khetha oko ungakuthetha ngendawo yomzobo wegqabi, uze ulungise isigqibo sakho nokuqiniseka.
y-m-14-08.s.s1.hint.0: Ngokolwazi olufunyenwe ukuza kuthi ga ngoku, bhala ngokwahlukeneyo amaxabiso amancinci nawona makhulu indawo enokuba nawo.
y-m-14-08.s.s1.hint.1: Thelekisa ukuba ulwazi olutsha lungena ngaphakathi koluhlu lwangaphambili okanye luphuma ngaphandle kwalo.
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.0.info: Xa wabala igridi, kwakukho izikwere ezili-14 ezingaphakathi ngokupheleleyo kumzobo wegqabi nezikwere ezili-12 ingqukumbela edlula kuzo, ngoko inxalenye kuphela ingaphakathi. Izikwere eziseleyo azigqagqani negqabi.
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ungatsho ntoni ngendawo yomzobo wegqabi kolu lwazi?
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.0.after: Izikwere ezingaphakathi ngokupheleleyo zonke zingaphakathi kwegqabi, ngoko indawo ayingaphantsi kwe-14 cm². Nokuba zonke izikwere ezidlulwa yingqukumbela zazizele ngokupheleleyo, ayinakudlula kwi-26 cm². Ngoko ungatsho ukuba ayingaphantsi kwe-14 cm² kwaye ayingaphezulu kwe-26 cm², kodwa olu lwazi aluchazi ukuba lelipi ixabiso eliphakathi.
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Indawo ngqo i-20 cm². Kungenxa yokuba lixabiso elibala izikwere ezili-12 ezingaphakathi inxalenye njengesiqingatha ngasinye.
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ukubala isiqingatha ngasinye yindlela enye yokuqikelela. Ayiqinisekiswanga ukuba lixabiso elichanekileyo.
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Indawo ayingaphantsi kwe-14 cm² kwaye ayingaphezulu kwe-26 cm²
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Esi sigqibo simisele amaxabiso amancinci nawona makhulu endawo sisebenzisa izikwere ezingaphakathi ngokupheleleyo nezikwere ezidlulwa yingqukumbela.
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Indawo ngqo i-14 cm². Kungenxa yokuba kubalwa kuphela izikwere ezingaphakathi ngokupheleleyo yaye izikwere ezidlulwa yingqukumbela azibalwa.
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Olu cwangciso lwathatha indawo yezikwere ezingaphakathi inxalenye njengo-0. Kukho igqabi nakwezo zikwere.
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ungaqikelela ukuba imalunga ne-20 cm², kodwa awazi ukuba ixabiso elichanekileyo likuphi phakathi kwe-14 ne-26
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Esi sigqibo sasebenzisa uqikelelo kwangaxeshanye sithi asilo ixabiso elichanekileyo.
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.0.o.e: Ezinye izikwere zinqunyulwa yigqabi inxalenye kuphela, ngoko indawo inokuba nkulu kune-26 cm²
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.0.r.e: Nokuba izikwere ezili-12 ezidlulwa yingqukumbela zikhulu kangangoko kunokwenzeka, isixa si-26 cm². Izikwere ezingaphandle kwegqabi azibalwa kwindawo.
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.1.info: Ukufumana ngokuchanekileyo ngakumbi, uHyunwoo watshintsha igridi yaba ziikwere ezinamacala angama-0.5 cm waza wabala kwakhona. Indawo yesikwere esinye yi-0.25 cm². Kwakukho iikwere ezi-66 ezingaphakathi ngokupheleleyo neekwere ezingama-20 ezingaphakathi ngokuyinxalenye kuphela.
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ngolu lwazi lutsha, ungathini ngoku ngendawo yomzobo wegqabi?
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.1.after: Xa ubala kwakhona ngeekwere ezincinci, elona xabiso lincinci li-66×0.25=16.5 cm² kwaye elona xabiso likhulu li-(66+20)×0.25=21.5 cm². Ububanzi boluhlu bancipha ukusuka kwi-12 cm² ukuya kwi-5 cm². Uluhlu olutsha lungaphakathi koluhlu lwangaphambili lwe-14 ukuya kwi-26, ngoko isigwebo sangaphambili sasingaphosisanga, kwaye uqikelelo 'malunga nama-20 cm²' lungaphakathi koluhlu olutsha nalo.
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Indawo ingu-16.5 cm² ubuncinane kwaye ingu-21.5 cm² ubuninzi, kwaye 'malunga nama-20 cm²' ungaphakathi koku nawo
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Esi sigwebo sibone ukuba uluhlu lwanda lwaba lwancinci ngolwazi olutsha, saza sahlola ukuba uqikelelo lwangaphambili lungaphakathi koluhlu olutsha na.
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Kuvele kutsha ukuba ingxelo yangaphambili 'ubuncinane ama-14 cm² nobuninzi ama-26 cm²' yayiphosisile
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Lo mbono wathatha uluhlu lwangaphambili noluhlu olutsha njengoluphikisanayo. Uluhlu olutsha lungaphakathi koluhlu lwangaphambili.
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Indawo imiselwe kwi-19 cm² ngqo. Oku kungenxa yokuba lixabiso eliphakathi ngqo le-16.5 ne-21.5
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Lo mbono wathatha ixabiso eliphakathi njengexabiso elichanekileyo. Zisekho iikwere ezingama-20 ezingaphakathi ngokuyinxalenye.
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Nangona iikwere zancipha, zikho iikwere ezingaphakathi ngokuyinxalenye, ngoko uluhlu loqikelelo luye lwanda
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Esi sigwebo senziwe ngaphandle kokubala ukuba ububanzi boluhlu butshintshe njani. Thelekisa ububanzi boluhlu lwangaphambili noluhlu olutsha.
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.2.info: UMina wabala iikwere ezingaphakathi ngokuyinxalenye njengesiqingatha ngasinye. Ngeekwere ze-0.5 cm yi-66+20÷2=76 iikwere, kwaye wathi 76×0.25=19 cm².
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.2.ask: Sinokuyibona njani i-19 cm² efunyenwe nguMina?
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.2.after: I-19 cm² ilele phakathi kwe-16.5 cm² ne-21.5 cm², ngoko ayiphikisani nesiphumo sangaphambili. Ukubala isiqingatha ngasinye luqikelelo olucinga ukuba iikwere ezidlulwa yingqukuva zizele phantse kwisiqingatha ngokomndilili, ngoko awukwazi ukuthi lixabiso elichanekileyo.
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Yindawo echanekileyo. Kuba indlela yokubala isiqingatha ngasinye ihlala inika ixabiso elichanekileyo.
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Lo mbono wathatha ixabiso elibaliwe ngeziqingatha njengexabiso elichanekileyo.
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Luqikelelo olulele ngaphakathi koluhlu kwaye aluphikisani nesiphumo sangaphambili, kodwa asilolo ixabiso elichanekileyo
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Esi sigwebo sithelekise noluhlu kwaye sathi nemida yoqikelelo.
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ingaphandle kwe-16.5 cm² ukuya kwi-21.5 cm², ngoko kufuneka sicinge ukuba into ibalwe kakubi
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Esi sigwebo senziwe ngaphandle kokuhlola ukuba u-19 ungaphakathi koluhlu na.
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Ubungakanani beekwere butshintshile, ngoko abunakuthelekiswa nesiphumo sangaphambili kwaye buphathwa ngokwahlukileyo
y-m-14-08.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Nangona ubungakanani beekwere butshintshile, indawo yeyegqabi elifanayo, ngoko iziphumo zinokuthelekiswa.
y-m-14-08.s.s1.reflect: Jonga indlela 'uluhlu onokuluthi' olutshintshe ngayo ixesha ngalinye ulwazi lunyuka. Ekuqaleni lwalubanzi, 14 ukuya kwi-26, kodwa njengoko iikwere zaba zintle lwancipha lwaya kwi-16.5 ukuya kwi-21.5. Wawungafuni ukulahla isigwebo sangaphambili (malunga nama-20 cm²), kodwa ukuzithemba kwakho kwanda. Ukutshintsha isigwebo nokunyusa ukuzithemba zizinto ezahlukeneyo.
y-m-14-08.s.s2.prompt: Xa uxelela umhlobo indawo yalo mzobo wegqabi, bhala ukuba kutheni kungcono ukunika uluhlu kunye nalo kunokunika ixabiso elinye kuphela, ubhale nendlela onokulunciphisa ngayo uluhlu ngakumbi.
y-m-14-08.s.s2.hint.0: Jonga umva ukuba kwatshintsha ntoni xa ubungakanani beekwere batshintshwa ngaphambili.
y-m-14-08.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala okwenzeka kububanzi boluhlu xa inani leekwere ezingaphakathi ngokuyinxalenye lincipha.

y-m-14-08.s.s2.model.0: Asikwazi ukwazi indawo echanekileyo, sazi kuphela ukuba iphakathi kwe-16.5 cm² ne-21.5 cm², ngoko kungcono ukunika uluhlu. Ukuba senza igridi incinci, sinokunciphisa uluhlu ngakumbi.
y-m-14-08.s.s2.model.1: Ngenxa yeekwere ezigqunyelwe ngokuyinxalenye, ixabiso alinakumiselwa libe linye, ngoko kufuneka sixele 'ubuncinane ... nobuninzi ...'. Ukuba sihlula iikwere ngokufanelekileyo ngakumbi sibale kwakhona, zikho iikwere ezimbalwa ezigqunyelwe ngokuyinxalenye kwaye uluhlu luba lunciphe.
y-m-14-08.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ndinike isizathu sokuba iikwere ezimbalwa ezigqunyelwe ngokuyinxalenye zinciphisa uluhlu.
